svg.title: Andrea Salemi by the numbers
svg.desc: 5,159 GitHub contributions since 2020 (2020: 42, 2021: 229, 2022: 1731, 2023: 802, 2024: 772, 2025: 505, 2026: 1078). Language mix by files changed: TypeScript 91%, Svelte 6%, JavaScript 2%, SQL 1%, CSS 1%, HTML 0%. Highlights: led 15 engineers and 4 designers on a design system; 80% faster loading of 2-5 GB BIM models; real-time B2B auction platform for 1-5K users.
